description: Look up the plain-language definition of a privacy or data-protection term, from 'Law 25' and 'PIPEDA' to 'privacy officer', 'data breach', and AI governance concepts. Use this whenever someone asks what a term means, or when you need a precise definition before answering a Canadian privacy question. Terms are identified by slug (for example 'law-25'); use privacy_list_glossary_terms to discover slugs.
name: privacy_lookup_glossary_term
title: Look up a privacy glossary term
